description: July 6 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 6 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a July 6 birthday
paragraphs: Family is central to the 6th of July. Six is numerology's domestic number, Cancer is astrology's domestic sign, and the decan's Pluto sub-ruler adds loyalty that runs very deep, with the Sun fourteen degrees along. Traditional readings describe a devoted guardian of kin and friends. The growth edge is letting loved ones grow and change without taking it personally.

By noon UTC on July 6, the Sun has normally reached roughly 14° of Cancer. That places the date in the Cancer decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the second of three. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: Numerology of the July 6 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same July 6 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: July 6 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 6 is the 187th day of the year (188th in a leap year). In most years Leo season is under way by July 23, 17 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 6 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. July 6 is also the birthday of George W. Bush (1946), Frida Kahlo (1907) and Tenzin Gyatso (1935).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 6?
faq.answer: July 6 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 6 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 6?
faq.answer: By July 6 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 6?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a July 6 birthday are George W. Bush (1946), Frida Kahlo (1907) and Tenzin Gyatso (1935). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
